tools.name: getKilotestOverview
tools.description: Explains what Kilotest is, what its tools do, and how its results are structured. Use this before any other tool when the available tools or workflow are unclear. tools.name: listPages
tools.description: Lists all pages Kilotest has tested. Use this first to discover whether a page already has any reports before requesting a test. Returns, for each tested page, its description, URL, and the identifier of its latest available report.

tools.name: listIssues
tools.description: Lists the issues reported in one report, along with the history of all reports about the same page. Use this after listPages to switch to an earlier or later report or to begin examining this report. Returns the history and the basics about this report’s issues.

tools.name: listViolators
tools.description: Lists the elements of a tested page that were reported as exhibiting one issue in one report. Use this after listIssues to drill down from an issue to the elements violating rules belonging to that issue. Returns basics about each violating element.

tools.name: listDiagnoses
tools.description: Lists the diagnoses that rule engines gave for how one element exhibited one issue in one report. Use this after listViolators to get details about the element as a violator of the issue. tools.name: getReport
tools.description: Retrieves one entire report as JSON, with all of its issues, violators, and diagnoses. Use this instead of drilling down through listIssues, listViolators, and listDiagnoses when the full report is needed in one call. tools.name: requestNewTest
tools.description: Submits a request to test a page that has no report yet; queued for manager approval. Use orderNewTest instead for immediate, automatically approved testing. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.

tools.name: requestRetest
tools.description: Submits a request to retest a page whose existing report is considered obsolete; queued for manager approval. Use orderRetest instead for immediate, automatically approved retesting. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.

tools.name: requestFeature
tools.description: Submits a request to add a new feature or improve an existing one; queued for manager review. There is no immediate-approval alternative for feature requests. Returns a request confirmation with disposition details.

tools.name: orderNewTest
tools.description: Orders testing of a page that has no report yet, with automated approval or rejection and immediate enqueueing if approved. Use this instead of requestNewTest when immediate testing is wanted; testing typically takes 2 to 4 minutes. Returns an order confirmation and disposition details, including, i

tools.name: orderRetest
tools.description: Orders a retest of a page whose existing report is considered obsolete, with automated approval or rejection and immediate enqueuing if approved. Use this instead of requestRetest when immediate retesting is wanted; testing typically takes 2 to 4 minutes. Returns an order confirmation and dispositio

tools.name: awaitTest
tools.description: Waits for a job ordered via the orderNewTest or orderRetest tool to finish, using the report identifier either tool returned. findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "listReports" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "listIssues" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Provide details about one report, including basics about the issues reported in it." → after: "Lists the issues reported in one report, along with the history of all reports about the same page. Use this after listPages to switch to an earlier or later report or to begin examining this report. Returns the history and the basics about this report’s issues."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
